# Car body dimensions
car_length = 200  # x-direction
car_width = 100   # y-direction
car_height = 100  # z-direction

# Wheel dimensions
wheel_radius = 25
wheel_thickness = 10  # along y-axis

# Calculate wheel positions at the four bottom corners
# Wheels need to be embedded into the body, forming half-cylinders
# They should be oriented along Y-axis (pointing inward)

# For wheels on the left side (y=0), they point in positive Y direction
# For wheels on the right side (y=100), they point in negative Y direction

# Front-left wheel
fl_x = 0 + wheel_radius  # offset from front edge
fl_y = 0  # at left edge
fl_z = wheel_radius  # at bottom, centered on wheel

# Front-right wheel  
fr_x = 0 + wheel_radius  # offset from front edge
fr_y = car_width  # at right edge
fr_z = wheel_radius  # at bottom, centered on wheel

# Rear-left wheel

rl_z = wheel_radius  # at bottom, centered on wheel

# Rear-right wheel
